avis.titre: Truly invisible patches that are comfortable all day and ...
avis.texte: I have struggled with acne since I was about 10 years old, so I've tried nearly every product out there. The new trend of pimple patches have actually been really useful, but I struggle with how obvious many of them look or that I can't find the right size. PanOxyl Daytime Invisible Patches with Salicylic Acid solves both of these problems for me while also being effective against acne. First, I appreciate that one package gives me two different sizes of pimple patches to choose from: one about the diameter of a pencil eraser, and one between a dime and nickel size. Sometimes my pimples are small and sometimes I have a large cluster to cover, so I like not having to buy multiple products to choose from. Next, these patches truly are nearly invisible! I had to look really closely myself to see them on my skin, and no one was able to notice when I was wearing them unless they stared hard (and I asked!). I was shocked when after just a few hours of wear, the patch ballooned out, filled with all the white gunk it was pulling from the acne. These patches truly covered up the redness of my acne while wearing, and brought down the visibility after, shrinking it significantly and reducing pain. They were comfortable to wear, too!

The Daytime Invisible Patches excel at what they promise: they are virtually undetectable on bare skin and lay flat and secure under light makeup all day. Unlike typical hydrocolloid dots, these contain Salicylic Acid and soothing extracts (Centella, Green Tea), meaning they actively treat the blemish by unclogging the pore while providing protection. However, because they are so thin, they lack the strong 'gunk-sucking' power of thicker, pure hydrocolloid patches (like PanOxyl's PM version). They are not effective for deep, cystic acne, and some users find they pull on skin when removed.
